quotes.speaker: Tom Kelly
quotes.text: Although Allen was manifestly the best of the two Gallagher got in one of those punches that puts a man to sleep and beat Allen in three rounds.

fights.excerpt: Gallagher got in one of those punches that puts a man to sleep and beat Allen in three rounds
fights.notes: Recalled by Tom Kelly, who says it was back in '69 in this city (St. Louis). The article gives Gallagher's name only, not Charley.

fights.notes: Rematch, undated ('later'). Tom Kelly seconded Gallagher and Allen won easily.

notes: Allen's training role and letters come from the paper's report on Fred Watkins. The $5,000 check is Watkins's, not Allen's, so it is not recorded.
